title: Assigned to DP Core — VCMP module
description: Onboarded onto the dataplane core team with the VCMP module. Started with small, well-scoped tasks to build familiarity with the codebase, the test infrastructure, and how SD-WAN traffic actually flows.

title: Customer-facing defects (CFDs)
description: Took on escalation-level issues with real customer impact — tunnel reliability, zero-byte flow reporting. Each one required deep root-cause analysis before any fix or handoff.

title: VCMP regression — co-owning the baseline
description: Drove VCMP regression alongside a colleague in the early stages, helping establish a stable test baseline for the module. This was the first real exposure to how the module behaves end-to-end under test conditions.

title: IPv6 & dual-stack coverage
description: IPv6 support across the feature was patchy and inconsistent. Fixed a cluster of interconnected issues, supporting dual-stack traffic: a double-applied PMTU constraint causing wrong MSS, broken fragmentation MSS parsing after a logging change, crashing IPv6 flow verification helpers, and misconfigured failover MTU paths.

title: BizPolicy module — full ownership, green run
description: Took complete ownership of the BizPolicy test module — an unfamiliar module — diagnosed its failures, and drove it to a clean green run. Not just fixing what was assigned, but taking responsibility for the module's overall health and test stability.

title: SD-WAN analytics — PR-ready investigation
description: Led a comprehensive investigation into VCO metric discrepancies spanning flow stats, linkstats, chatstats, and iptables. Delivered a PR-ready validation suite, customer-facing documentation, and surfaced two independent bugs — a chatstats defect and a mis-propagated fragmentation flag.

title: OpenWRT platform & automation infrastructure
description: Worked on OpenWRT-based hardware, Hypervisor and Cloud platform supported routing systems' infrastructure for the VeloCloud product — the product that made Software Defined WAN mainstream. Focused on maintaining and automating system configurations and automation infrastructure across devices.

title: SBOM — Packages-Libraries-Dependencies analysis
description: Added a Packages-Libraries-Dependencies analysis system for OpenWRT platforms that helps detect vulnerabilities within software, contributing to Arista's central SBOM (Software Bill of Materials) system.

title: Working across the full stack
description: What started as a single module assignment has grown into genuine cross-stack fluency. Every bug followed to its actual root cause, regardless of where it lived.
